description: FAQ accordion using native HTML details/summary elements. Zero JavaScript required. Each item has a question and an HTML answer. Always emits a FAQPage JSON-LD structured-data block alongside the visible markup.

id.description: Optional HTML id attribute for anchor linking (e.g. navigation anchors). Also becomes the component's stable id.

title.description: Section heading displayed above the FAQ list.

title_accent.description: Optional exact substring of title to render in an accent color. Must match title exactly (case-sensitive) or it is ignored.

eyebrow.description: Optional short kicker/label rendered as a pill above the title.

theme.description: Background color/tone for this band. 'default' = the band's own default background (no tone override). 'muted' = light tinted surface band (renders the --color-surface background with framing top and bottom borders). 'inverted' = inverted dark background for strong contrast; use 'inverted' for a genuinely dark band.

items.description: Array of FAQ items. Each item: { question: string, answer: string (HTML allowed) }.

question.description: The question text shown in the accordion summary. Plain text — HTML is escaped.

answer.description: The answer body. Rich HTML (sanitized via wp_kses_post): block-level markup, lists, and links are allowed.

--faq-padding-top.description: Top padding of the band. Defaults to the shared symmetric band rhythm (fluid ~68-80px desktop, ~54px mobile); set an explicit length to override.

--faq-padding-bottom.description: Bottom padding of the band. Defaults to the shared symmetric band rhythm; set an explicit length to override.

--faq-item-bg.description: Individual accordion item background color or gradient. DELIBERATELY not re-declared on the inverted variant: the items stay light on a dark band (the same choice grid makes for its cards), so an inverted FAQ shows light panels on the dark band rather than dark-on-dark. Set this slot if you want the items to follow the band instead.

--faq-eyebrow-radius.description: Eyebrow pill corner radius. Set a large value (e.g. 999px) for a fully rounded pill.

--faq-eyebrow-border-width.description: Eyebrow pill border width. Set a non-zero width (with --faq-eyebrow-border-color) for an outlined pill; 0 (default) renders no border.

--faq-eyebrow-border-color.description: Eyebrow pill border color. Takes effect when --faq-eyebrow-border-width is non-zero.

--faq-eyebrow-text-transform.description: Eyebrow pill letter-casing. Default uppercase renders the kicker in caps; set none to keep it as authored (e.g. sentence case), or lowercase / capitalize.

--faq-heading-size.description: Section heading font size. Defaults to the shared responsive band-heading scale (fluid ~28px mobile to ~42px desktop), which every band heading in the theme routes. LEAVE IT UNSET unless THIS band must differ from the rest of the site: retuning every band heading at once is ONE update_design_token write on --pp-band-heading-size, not one slot write per band.

--faq-heading-color.description: Section heading text color. Defaults to the theme text colour (the inverted variant supplies its own light default). LEAVE IT UNSET unless THIS band must differ: recolouring every heading on the site is ONE update_design_token write on --color-text, not one slot write per band.

--faq-heading-measure.description: Maximum width of the FAQ section heading. Routes the shared --measure-heading design token (40rem) by default, so retuning that ONE token changes every routed band heading at once; set a length here only when THIS band must differ from the rest of the site.

--faq-body-measure.description: Maximum width of an FAQ ANSWER. Default "none": answers already sit inside the accordion item's padded box. Set a length to hold a long answer to a reading measure; "none" restores the default.

--faq-heading-accent-color.description: Color of the title_accent substring within the heading. Ignored unless title_accent is set AND occurs as a substring of title — no accent span is rendered otherwise, so this slot has nothing to colour.

--faq-heading-margin-bottom.description: Space below the FAQ heading, before the accordion list (header rhythm). Lower it to tighten the header, raise it for more separation. 1.65rem is the effective default at desktop (>=768px); below 768px it is 1.25rem.

--faq-question-color.description: Question (summary) text color in the CLOSED/resting state ONLY. Its positional twin is --faq-question-open-color, which owns the expanded state and the chevron — a colour set here alone reverts the moment the reader opens the item, so set both or neither. This slot ALSO colours the disclosure chevron at rest, for free: the chevron is drawn with currentColor borders, so it inherits whatever this slot resolves to and needs no slot of its own. Only the chevron's box (10px) and stroke (2px) are stated defaults — it is a control affordance, not a style surface, and its box sits inside the ruled 44px touch target.

--faq-answer-color.description: Answer text color. var(--color-text-secondary) is the effective default at desktop (>=768px); below 768px it is var(--color-muted).

--faq-item-radius.description: Accordion item corner radius. faq owns this value independently — before issue 577 the rendered radius came from the grid component's card slot, which faq could neither set nor resolve.

--faq-question-open-color.description: Open-state question text color and chevron color — the positional twin of --faq-question-color, which owns the closed/resting state. The two MUST stay visually distinct or the open item loses its affordance.
--faq-question-open-color.conditionality_note: the question is OPEN — the accordion's expanded state, which is interaction state rather than authored data

do_not_touch: schema.json without updating this component's README.md and the repo-root AI_CONTEXT.md
